During the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] deployed a '''transport''' to the far side of a ridge overlooking [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] in an attempt to flank the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] forces. Deploying a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] [[Company/Legends|company]] supported by five [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|All Terrain Scout Transports]], the force was stopped in a narrow pass by four squads of foot soldiers and three [[Snowspeeder/Legends|snowspeeders]].<ref name="Marooned" />
